description: Checks the published Preference Manager widget read on preference-api.preference-management.usercentrics.eu/public/widgets/{widgetUuid}. Authentication, preference writes, and the CMP script hosts stay outside this pack.

params.name: widget_uuid
params.description: The Preference Manager guide says widgetUuid is the unique identifier of the widget. The example is a UUID, and the page does not publish a character grammar, so only presence is checked.
params.fix_hint: Put the widget id from the Admin UI in the path so it reads /public/widgets/{widgetUuid}.

params.name: language
params.description: The guide says language is an optional list of ISO 639-1 codes, and the examples are en and de. This check warns unless a value is two letters. It does not check membership in the ISO catalog.
params.fix_hint: Set language to a two-letter code such as en, or omit it to receive the English widget.
